E14c is explained in part (grid fit by the font's gasp table: worst edge 2 px -> 1 px with grid fit off; baseline floored to a whole device pixel), not closed; no product change was made.
The probe exe is a diagnostic built by .github/workflows/probe-f0-text.yml; it is never a renderer.

blocks.casesPassingDecidingGate: 139/139 corpus cases (decode buffers vs the Mac ImageIO oracle, 20 identical Windows runs); no paired capture case
caveats: Buffer gate only: no pixel capture; `Image(decorative: CGImage, ...)` draws through the block 35 pixel path unchanged.

Lossless formats byte-exact (RGB under alpha 0 ignored); JPEG 4:4:4 max 3, 4:2:0 max 16 (chroma upsampling), P3 max 1, thumbnails max 98 (box filter vs ImageIO's, I2 owns the real tolerance); CMYK JPEG max 58 / mean 14.1 from the Mac (not fitted).

WIC's own colour transform gamut-maps and ignores the rendering intent; matrix/TRC profiles are converted in Swift (clip, within 1 of CoreGraphics); LUT, grey and CMYK profiles use the WIC transform and are not gated.
ImageIO ignores the AND mask of 24-bit ICO entries and cannot decode BITMAPV4HEADER BMPs; those cases are gated against the pure-Swift decoder and the V5 decode.
The pure-Swift PNG/ICO decoder remains the default (`ImageDecoder.backend`); the system backend is selected with SWIFTRIGHT_IMAGE_DECODER=system.
One Windows build (10.0.26100, WindowsCodecs 10.0.26100.9711); macOS 27.0.1 oracle.
